author: TheHackerWire
text: CVE-2026-62863 (CVSS 9.6 Critical): Unauthenticated /sse & /message endpoints with wildcard CORS in MoLing MCP Server (< 0.5.0) let malicious web pages trigger localhost RCE. Upgrade MoLing to >= v0.5.0 or disable SSE mode.

author: Iam_Shivanshu
text: Your MCP server checked the token's signature, issuer and expiry. It never checked who the token was for. GHSA-4prq-p2x5-w9fh / CVE-2026-115413 in awslabs.aws-api-mcp-server. High, CVSS 7.3.

author: botnewsnetwork
text: Two missing checks in Datalayer's jupyter-mcp-server let any website hijack an AI assistant's live notebook connection; a frontier model never noticed the swap (Pluto Security research disclosure).

author: markgadala
text: Major security breach hits Northflank, a cloud platform used to deploy production apps, databases and AI workloads.

author: ParameterWatch
text: CVE-2026-63377 (9.8): TAKO AI Agent for Okta, a local AI tool that lets Okta admins query tenant data, lets anyone on the network create the first admin account. Versions before 3.0.1-beta affected; upgrade to 3.0.1-beta.

author: aviatrixtrc
text: Attackers are exploiting CVE-2026-97229, a CVSS 10.0 integer overflow in GitLab's CI/CD regex compiler, achieving unauthenticated RCE; post-compromise privilege escalation via harvested CI/CD pipeline secrets observed.

author: iamnrdas
text: AWS disclosed CVE-2026-119117 in the Kinesis Producer Library for Java (<1.0.8). DEBUG logs and native process args may expose AWS credentials to local users. Upgrade to 1.0.8+, rotate keys if needed.

author: okey_amy
text: Northflank breached. Status page: assume all environment variables compromised, rotate everything now. Users confirming their AI keys are already being used.

author: cvedotnow
text: fctr-id okta-ai-agent: unauthenticated admin takeover via first-run setup (CVE-2026-63377). Patch to 3.0.1-beta.

author: stretchcloud
text: AI agents' bundled browsers run whatever Chromium they last cached, leaving them exposed to CVE-2026-85046, an actively exploited V8 type confusion bug Google patched in Chrome 152.0.7977.82.

author: notCVE
text: Actively exploited, added to CISA KEV 2026-10-30: CVE-2026-111357, Ivanti Connect Secure missing authentication for critical function vulnerability (CVSS 7).

author: stretchcloud
text: Stuffing JavaScript comments with nuclear and biological weapons terminology makes AI code scanners refuse to look at the file; now a documented malware evasion technique cataloged by security researchers.

author: infrastack_ai
text: New critical CVE-2026-62863 in MoLing MCP server (computer-use/browser-use MCP server), rated CVSS 9.6. The record does not yet describe the flaw or affected versions.

author: infrastack_ai
text: Northflank confirms breach on its status page after a Wiz threat alert at 11:43 UTC; tells customers to assume every env variable was decrypted and to disable and rotate all keys.

author: SpectraAudit
text: CISA flags two actively exploited vulnerabilities: GitLab RCE (CVE-2026-97229) & Cisco ASA/FTD firewall DoS (CVE-2026-76418), added to the KEV catalog.

author: hexawow
text: A Defense Contractor Gave Their Personal AI Agent Access to a Secure Pentagon System - Sources tell WIRED that an Accenture employee's personal Claude agent ran on a DOD network for two months before it was identified and the vulnerability could be patched.

author: isectech_
text: New CISA KEV (Oct 29): Cisco ASA/FTD CVE-2026-76418 (8.6, SSL VPN DoS, actively exploited) + GitLab CVE-2026-97229 (10.0, unauth RCE). Patch both federal due Sun Nov 1.

author: ThreatWire_
text: ACTIVELY EXPLOITED: Drupal Commerce Core authorization flaw (CVE-2026-118539, Highly critical 21/25). Attackers placed fraudulent orders on live shops, some at $0.01. No login needed. Affected: Commerce below 8.x-2.41, and 3.0.0 to 3.3.12; fixed 3.3.13.

author: CCBalert
text: Warning: CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS 10.0) in GitLab CE/EE is actively exploited by attackers. Exploitation allows unauthenticated remote attackers to achieve arbitrary code execution via specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration.

author: dailytechonx
text: A North Korea-aligned group now steals Git credentials and injects malware via npm, PyPI packages and GitHub, using blockchain tricks to avoid takedowns. Rotate keys and audit dependencies.

author: CCBalert
text: Warning: Linux Kernel Missing Initialization of a Variable Vulnerability, CVE-2026-46300 (CVSS 7.8), is actively exploited in the wild. Exploitation could allow a local attacker to achieve root privileges or container escape by corrupting read-only file page caches.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: New NetamLoader malware targets government Windows systems in Asia. Kaspersky uncovered a .NET malware framework for a customized Windows 10 build used by Asian government organizations; infection chain uses legitimate Patch My PC.

author: noelkimx
text: Agno's PandasTools passed a model-chosen function name to getattr, so a prompt injection could make the agent call read_pickle on an attacker's file and run code (CVE-2026-119050).

author: fireball_triada
text: A malicious MCP server can run PowerShell on your PC during OAuth sign-in. OpenCode 1.0.137-1.18.32 on Windows/WSL passed the server's auth URL to open@10.x, so $(...) executes. Root cause: CVE-2026-119025. Fixed silently, no advisory.

author: ITBriefcase
text: Black October 2026: PHP2Shell, a 14-year-old flaw in production code, found by AI in 2026. Cairn campaign: AI agents autonomously breached 1,200+ websites.

author: NoDramaCyber
text: CISA added GitLab CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS 10, unauthenticated RCE via a crafted CI/CD regex) and Cisco ASA/FTD CVE-2026-76418 (remote DoS) to KEV on Oct 29; federal deadline Nov 1.

author: EnigmaGlobalSW
text: Node2Shell (CVE-2026-111497): Actively Exploited Out-of-Bounds Write in Google Brotli Decoder Enables RCE in Node.js, Bun, Python, .NET, PAN-OS and VMware SDDC Manager

author: EnigmaGlobalSW
text: Intel Report [HIGH] Brazilian Magecart Group Compromises Convertr E-Commerce Platform via Plausible Analytics Supply Chain Attack

author: ita_ipo
text: Binance confirms record $6.3B crypto heist tied to North Korea's TraderTraitor, ~$3B frozen. GitLab RCE CVE-2026-97229, CVSS 10.0, actively exploited, added to CISA's KEV. Cisco SD-WAN auth-bypass also under APT attack.

author: infrastack_ai
text: The official Claude Code VS Code extension was hit in a supply chain attack, and version 2.1.313 shipped a loader that installs a persistent SSH backdoor, adds the attacker's SSH key, and sends host data out. Up to 5,000 users installed it.

author: MarcosRGjr
text: A remote MCP server can run code on your machine before it lists a single tool. OpenCode 1.0.137 to 1.18.32 and MCP Inspector 2.0 to 2.11 passed the server's OAuth sign-in URL to a browser opener that wrapped it in PowerShell on Windows and WSL.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Supply chain attack on Anthropic's official Claude Code VSCode extension (version 2.1.313) delivered an SSH reverse backdoor to developer machines, silently patched without customer notification.

author: Arslanbhtti9733
text: Cursor disclosed a supply-chain attack: a malicious version of Anthropic's Claude Code extension (2.1.313) was distributed through its marketplace for about 11 hours on October 29, 2026, attempting to steal system data and plant SSH backdoors; up to 5,000 users affected.

author: rayvahey
text: Official Claude Code VS Code extension (v2.1.313) compromised in a supply chain attack. Attackers injected a malicious loader that installs a persistent SSH backdoor, adds their SSH key, and exfiltrates host data. Up to ~5,000 users installed the malicious version.

author: Netlas_io
text: Actively exploited RCE and other new WordPress vulnerabilities, no CVE assigned yet, 8.1 rating. The recently disclosed unauthenticated race-condition vulnerability in the WordPress Core update process can lead to remote code execution.

author: ai_dev_official
text: 26,400 working credentials were sitting in public Gitee repositories. Researchers scanned ~7.25M public repos; that includes 9,473 Alibaba Cloud key pairs and 3,170 DeepSeek keys.

author: Iam_Shivanshu
text: AWS bulletin 2026-097-AWS / CVE-2026-85654 / GHSA-35jj-hwvm-792x. Code injection in the CDK generator inside awslabs.dynamodb-mcp-server.

author: Teti_sf
text: Binance & Polymarket on Oct 29: two separate incidents. Binance ~$6.3B, largest crypto hack on record, via a compromised DevOps engineer's laptop giving access to a service container. Polymarket hit via a compromised DebugBear third-party script (supply chain).

author: BytesNora
text: Cisco SD-WAN Zero-Day Exploitation Tied to Volt Typhoon's 'Silent Train' Network (CVE-2026-20127, actively exploited)

author: Brainrot_Labs
text: GoPlus Security traced the Polymarket International incident to a compromised third-party monitoring script from DebugBear, a confirmed supply chain attack.
